#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MODULUS = 998244353;

vector<int> get_factors_list(long long n) {
    vector<int> result;
    for (long long i = 1; i * i <= n; ++i) {
        if (n % i == 0) {
            result.push_back((int)i);
            if (i != n / i) {
                result.push_back((int)(n / i));
            }
        }
    }
    std::sort(result.begin(), result.end());
    result.erase(std::unique(result.begin(), result.end()), result.end());
    return result;
}

long long modular_pow(long long n) {
    return pow(n, MODULUS - 2) == 0 ? 0 : pow(n, MODULUS - 2);
}

vector<int> read_numbers() {
    vector<int> res;
    int temp; 
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        cin >> temp;
        res.push_back(temp);
    }
    return res;
}

vector<int> read_int_list() {
    vector<int> res;
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    int num;
    while (iss >> num) {
        res.push_back(num);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n = read_integer();

    vector<int> rock1 = read_numbers();
    vector<int> sci1 = read_numbers();
    vector<int> paper1 = read_numbers();

    vector<int> rock2 = read_numbers();
    vector<int> sci2 = read_numbers();
    vector<int> paper2 = read_numbers();

    auto get_max = [&]() {
        return min(rock1[0], sci2[0]) + min(sci1[0], paper2[0]) + min(paper1[0], rock2[0]);
    };

    auto get_match = [](int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        else
            return -1;
    };

    auto compute_score = [&](std::vector<std::vector<int>> l1, std::vector<std::vector<int>> l2) {
        int total = 0;
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
        while (!l1.empty() || !l2.empty()) {
            if (c1 == 0 && !l1.empty()) {
                c1 = l1.back()[0];
                int type1 = l1.back()[1];
                l1.pop_back();
                c1 = c1; // keep count
                // store type if needed
                // for simplicity, we can store as pair and do accordingly
                // but for now, assume c1 and c2 hold counts and type separately
            }
            if (c2 == 0 && !l2.empty()) {
                c2 = l2.back()[0];
                int type2 = l2.back()[1];
                l2.pop_back();
            }
            if (c1 == 0 || c2 == 0) break; // no more pairs

            int match_value = max(0, min(c1, c2) * get_match( l1.size() ? l1.back()[1] : 0, l2.size() ? l2.back()[1] : 0 ));
            total += match_value;

            if (c1 < c2) {
                c2 -= c1;
                c1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                c1 -= c2;
                c2 = 0;
            } else {
                c1 = c2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return total;
    };

    auto find_min_score = [&]() {
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> perms1;
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> perms2;
        vector<vector<int>> base1 = {{rock1[0],1},{sci1[0],2},{paper1[0],3}};
        vector<vector<int>> base2 = {{rock2[0],1},{sci2[0],2},{paper2[0],3}};
        do { perms1.push_back(base1); } while (std::next_permutation(base1.begin(), base1.end()));
        do { perms2.push_back(base2); } while (std::next_permutation(base2.begin(), base2.end()));

        int min_ans = INT_MAX;
        for (auto &p1 : perms1) {
            for (auto &p2 : perms2) {
                vector<vector<int>> p1_copy = p1;
                vector<vector<int>> p2_copy = p2;
                min_ans = min(min_ans, compute_score(p1_copy, p2_copy));
            }
        }
        return min_ans;
    };

    cout << find_min_score() << " " << get_max() << "\n";
    return 0;
}
